brand.caption: Civic infrastructure • Sangli
brand.prototypeNotice: NagarSetu is an educational college prototype. It is not an official municipal or government portal.

password.ruleNew: At least {{min}} characters, different from the current one.
password.tooLong: This password is too long. Use a shorter one.

hero.title: Report. Track. See it fixed.
hero.body: One place for citizens, department admins and repair contractors to follow a civic issue from report to verified repair.
hero.point1: Report with a photo and the exact location
hero.point3: Repairs are checked by an admin before closing

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Use the email and password of your NagarSetu account.
login.staffNote: Department admins and contractors log in here too, with the email their account was created with.
login.invalidHelp: Check your email and password, or reset your password.
login.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
login.passwordReset: Your password has been changed. Log in with the new password.

signup.title: Create citizen account
signup.subtitle: Report civic issues and follow them until they are fixed.
signup.citizensOnly: Department admins and contractors get their accounts from the NagarSetu team or a department admin.
signup.emailHint: We will email you a 6-digit code to verify this address.

invalid.name: Enter your name (at least 2 characters).
invalid.phone: Enter a phone number with at least 10 digits.

otp.title: Verify your email
otp.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to:
otp.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in
otp.resent: A new code has been sent.
otp.notSent: We could not send the code just now. Ask for a new one below.
otp.later: You need a verified email to report issues or upvote. You can also verify later.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account email. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If this email is registered, a reset link is on its way. It works once and expires in {{minutes}} minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: This logs you out on every device.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
changePassword.requiredBody: This is your first login. Replace the initial password you were given before you continue.

blocked.deactivatedBody: You can't log in with this account. Contact the department admin who manages your account.
blocked.lockedBody: Login is paused after several wrong passwords. Wait for the timer, or reset your password to unlock the account now.

invite.title: Set up your contractor account
invite.subtitle: A department admin invited you to NagarSetu. Check your details and choose a password.
invite.expires: This link works once and expires on {{date}}.
invite.askAdmin: Ask the admin who invited you for a new link.

home.verifyBody: You need a verified email before you can report an issue or upvote.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page doesn't exist or you don't have access to it.

error.NOT_AN_IMAGE: That file is not a photo. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
error.UNREADABLE: This photo could not be opened. Try taking it again.
error.TOO_SMALL: This photo is too small. Take a new one.

errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Can't reach NagarSetu. Check your connection and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details are not valid. Check the form and try again.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to this.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{retryAfterMinutes}} minutes.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email already exists. Log in instead.
errors.OTP_EXPIRED: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.OTP_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.
errors.OTP_COOLDOWN: Please wait {{retryAfterSeconds}} seconds before asking for a new code.
errors.PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: Choose a password different from the current one.
errors.RESET_LINK_INVALID: This reset link is invalid, already used or expired.
errors.INVITE_NOT_FOUND: This invite link is not valid.
errors.INVITE_USED: This invite link has already been used.
errors.OUTSIDE_SERVICE_AREA: This spot is outside the area NagarSetu covers (Sangli, Miraj and Kupwad).
errors.CANNOT_WITHDRAW: The department has already accepted this report, so it can't be withdrawn.
errors.PHOTO_REQUIRED: Add a photo of the problem.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.UNREADABLE_IMAGE: This photo could not be read. Take it again.
errors.IMAGE_TOO_SMALL: This photo is too small. Take a new one.
errors.PHOTO_TOO_LARGE: This photo is too large. Take a new one.
errors.UNKNOWN_CATEGORY: Choose a category from the list.
errors.RETAKE_NOT_REQUESTED: A new photo is not needed for this report.
errors.NOT_RESOLVED: Feedback opens once the issue is resolved.
errors.FEEDBACK_WINDOW_CLOSED: The time to answer for this repair has ended.
errors.ALREADY_RESPONDED: You already answered for this repair.
errors.PHOTO_ONLY_FOR_NOT_FIXED: A photo can only be added to a "not fixed" answer.
errors.ALREADY_HANDLED: Someone else already handled this. Reload to see the latest.
errors.ALREADY_REVIEWED: This repair evidence was already reviewed.
errors.CONTRACTOR_INVITE_PENDING: This contractor hasn't accepted the invite yet.
errors.DIFFERENT_CATEGORY: A duplicate must be in the same category. Reroute the report first.
errors.ISSUE_NOT_OPEN: Only open issues can be reassigned.
errors.NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED: Accept the report before assigning it.
errors.NO_DISPUTE: There is no open dispute on this issue.
errors.PRIORITY_REQUIRED: Set the final priority before assigning.
errors.SUBMISSION_PENDING: Review the waiting repair evidence first.
errors.TARGET_NOT_ACTIVE: That issue is closed. Link to an open one.
errors.DEADLINE_IN_PAST: The deadline must be in the future.
errors.DEADLINE_TOO_FAR: The deadline must be within a year.
errors.SAME_CATEGORY: The report is already in that category.
errors.SAME_ISSUE: An issue can't be a duplicate of itself.
errors.PRIORITY_REASON_REQUIRED: Give a reason, because you chose differently from the AI suggestion.
errors.INVITE_ALREADY_ACCEPTED: This contractor has already set a password.
errors.ALREADY_STARTED: Work on this job has already started.
errors.NOT_STARTED: Start the work before sending evidence.
errors.REQUEST_ID_REUSED: Something went wrong with this upload. Go back and try again.
errors.ISSUE_NOT_IN_PROGRESS: This job is not in progress.

gate.title: Verify your email to report
gate.body: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Enter it once and you can report issues.
gate.why1: It keeps reports from fake accounts out.
gate.why2: You get updates on your reports in the app.

photo.title: Take a photo of the problem
photo.body: One clear photo helps the department understand the problem quickly.
photo.tip1: Show the whole problem, in daylight if you can.
photo.tip2: Stand where the department's team would stand.
photo.tip3: Avoid people's faces and number plates.

location.title: Where is it?
location.body: Move the pin to the exact spot. You can also search for a place or use your location.

details.title: What is the problem?
details.body: Choose the category and describe what you see.
details.placeholder: For example: deep pothole in the middle of the road, near the bus stop
details.languageHint: Write in English, Hindi or Marathi, or Hindi/Marathi in English letters. We keep your words as written.

review.title: Check and send
review.body: Make sure everything is right. You can't change the report after sending it.
review.noGps: No device location was added. That's fine: the department uses the pin.
review.final: After sending, only the department can change the report (for example, move it to another category). You can withdraw it until the department accepts it.

location.searchHint: Press Enter or the search button.
location.searchFailed: Search is not available right now. Move the pin by hand instead.
location.noResults: No places found in the NagarSetu area. Try another name or move the pin.
location.tapHint: Tap the map to place the pin

gps.DENIED: Location permission is off. You can still place the pin by hand.
gps.UNAVAILABLE: Your location is not available. You can still place the pin by hand.
gps.TIMEOUT: Finding your location took too long. You can place the pin by hand.

location.addressHint: Helps the team find the spot, e.g. "opposite the post office".

duplicate.title: Is this the same problem?
duplicate.body: Similar reports are already open nearby. If one of them is your problem, support it instead of sending a new report.
duplicate.submitAnyway: No, mine is different. Send my report

retry.title: Connection lost
retry.body: Your report hasn't reached NagarSetu yet. We keep trying while this screen is open.
retry.safe: Trying again is safe: it can never create a second report.

submitted.title: Thank you, your report is in
submitted.body: The department will review it. You will get updates here in the app.
submitted.saved: Your report is saved. Open it later from My complaints.
submitted.next1: We check your photo automatically (this can take a minute).
submitted.next2: The department accepts the report, or tells you why not.
submitted.next3: A contractor fixes it and the department checks the repair photo.

supported.title: You now support this report
supported.body: No new report was sent and your photo was not uploaded. You'll get the same updates as the person who reported it.
supported.point1: The department sees how many people are affected.
supported.point2: Support doesn't change the priority or send anyone by itself; the department decides.
supported.point3: When it is fixed, you can say whether it really is.

validation.checkingBody: This usually takes under a minute. Your report is already saved.
validation.retakeBody: Our automatic check could not see the problem clearly in the photo. Your report is not rejected; a new photo helps the department.
validation.reviewTitle: A person will check your photo
validation.reviewBody: The automatic check wasn't sure, so the department will look at it. You don't need to do anything.
validation.okBody: Photo checked. The department will review your report.

suggestion.title: This may be a {{category}} issue
suggestion.body: You chose {{category}}. If needed, the department will move your report to the right category and tell you. You don't need to do anything.

complaints.title: My complaints
complaints.subtitle: Follow your reports and the ones you support.

empty.supporting: You don't support any reports yet
empty.supportingBody: When you choose "Yes, this is my problem" on a similar report, it appears here.

complaints.endedNote: Rejected, forwarded, linked to another report, or withdrawn. Open one to see why.
complaints.canWithdraw: You can withdraw this report until the department accepts it.

issue.notFoundBody: It doesn't exist, isn't public yet, or you can't see it.

closed.rejectedTitle: The department did not accept this report
closed.forwardedBody: This place isn't looked after by the municipal department. The reason says where it went.
closed.duplicateBody: The same problem was already reported. Your report and your support now count for that one.

resolution.title: Before and after
resolution.beforeAlt: Photo of the problem when it was reported
resolution.afterAlt: Repair photo approved by the department

feedback.question: Is it fixed?
feedback.explain: Your answer helps the department check the work. It doesn't reopen or close anything by itself.
feedback.closed: The time to answer for this repair has ended.

my.NOT_FIXED: You said it is not fixed

feedback.disputedNote: The department has been told and will decide what to do.

notFixed.title: Not fixed
notFixed.explain: Tell the department what is still wrong. They will look at it and decide; the report is not reopened automatically.
notFixed.placeholder: For example: the hole is back after the rain
notFixed.sent: Sent. The department will look at it.

retake.title: New photo
retake.body: Take a clear photo of the problem from where you stand.
retake.sent: New photo sent. We'll check it again.
retake.keep: Your report stays open while you do this.

withdraw.hint: You can withdraw this report until the department accepts it.
withdraw.title: Withdraw this report?
withdraw.body: The department will stop working on it. This can't be undone.

notifications.title: Alerts
notifications.subtitle: Updates on your reports and the ones you support.
notifications.emptyBody: You'll see an alert here when something happens to your reports.

type.REJECTED: The department did not accept the report
type.FORWARDED: The report was forwarded to another authority
type.REROUTED: The report was moved to another category
type.LINKED_DUPLICATE: The report was linked to an existing report
type.DISPUTE_DISMISSED: The department reviewed your "not fixed" answer
type.DISPUTE_RAISED: A citizen says it isn't fixed

contractor.subtitle: New jobs, deadline changes and the department's decisions on your evidence.
contractor.emptyBody: You'll see an alert here when a job is assigned to you or your evidence is checked.
contractor.ASSIGNMENT_ENDED: A job was given to someone else

profile.title: Profile
profile.languageHint: The app's language. Reports are kept in the language you wrote them in.
profile.notificationsBody: Updates arrive here in the app (Alerts). NagarSetu only sends email for your sign-up code and password reset links.

feed.title: Community feed
feed.subtitle: Public reports in Sangli, Miraj and Kupwad. A report appears here once its photo check passes or the department accepts it.
feed.emptyBody: Reports appear here once their photo check passes or the department accepts them.
feed.emptyFiltered: No public reports in this category yet

community.ownReport: You can't upvote your own report
community.verifyFirst: Verify your email to upvote and comment
community.closed: This report is closed for upvotes
community.upvoteNote: Upvotes show how many people care. They don't set the priority; the department does.
community.supportHint: Support it to get updates and to say whether the repair worked.
community.notPublic: Only you, its supporters and the department can see this report until its photo check passes or the department accepts it.

comments.title: Comments
comments.emptyBody: Add something useful, like how long the problem has been there.
comments.label: Your comment
comments.notPublicYet: Comments open once the report is public.
comments.reportBody: The department will look at it and can hide it.
comments.reportSent: Thanks. The department will review it.

publicMap.subtitle: Public reports. Pins show the approximate area, not the exact spot.
publicMap.truncated: Showing the newest {{count}} reports in this view. Zoom in to see all of them.
publicMap.none: No public reports in this part of the map.
publicMap.error: Couldn't load the reports for this area.

approx.title: Approximate area
approx.note: Shown within about {{radius}} m, to protect the reporter's privacy.

ai.title: AI suggestion
ai.note: The AI can be wrong. It never accepts, rejects or resolves anything; you decide.
ai.pending: The AI check hasn't finished yet. You can decide without it.
ai.pendingRetry_one: The AI check failed {{count}} time and will be retried. You can decide without it.
ai.pendingRetry_other: The AI check failed {{count}} times and will be retried. You can decide without it.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.reassign_one: {{count}} job is held by a deactivated contractor. Reassign it.
dashboard.reassign_other: {{count}} jobs are held by deactivated contractors. Reassign them.

issues.title: Issues
issues.subtitle: Your department's reports. Open one to review it; there are no bulk actions.
issues.searchHint: Reference (#3F8A2C10), words from the description, or an address
issues.caption: {{count}} issues

review.notFoundBody: It doesn't exist or belongs to another department.
review.original: Open the original photo (full size, with metadata)
review.distance: {{distance}} between them. A gap is a signal, not proof of anything.
review.noDevice: No phone location was shared. That is neutral, not suspicious.
review.communityNote: Upvotes show interest, not how serious the problem is.

closed.REJECTED: This report was rejected. The citizen was told why.
closed.FORWARDED: This report was forwarded as not our jurisdiction.
closed.DUPLICATE: This report is linked to another issue; its support counts there.

review.acceptBody: The report becomes Acknowledged and the citizen is told. You can set the final priority now or later.
review.rejectBody: The report is closed and the citizen sees your reason. This can't be undone.
review.forwardBody: The report is closed as forwarded and the citizen sees where it went and why.
review.forwardReason: Where it was forwarded, and why (shown to the citizen)
review.rerouteBody: If the new category belongs to another department, it moves there and leaves your list. The citizen is told.
review.linkBody: This report closes and its reporter and supporters are added to the open issue. Never automatic.
review.linkToBody: This report closes and its reporter and supporters are added to {{ref}}.
review.linkTarget: Open issue to link to (full id)
review.linkTargetHint: Copy the id from the issue's address bar, or use "Link this" in Possible duplicates.
review.priorityDiffers: Required: you chose differently from the AI suggestion ({{ai}}).
review.priorityBody: Only you set the final priority. Upvotes and the AI are signals.
review.priorityFirst: Set the final priority before assigning.
review.assignBody: The contractor is told in the app. The issue stays Acknowledged until they start.
review.reassignTitle: Give this job to another contractor?
review.reassignBody: {{name}} loses this job and is told. The new contractor gets a fresh deadline.
review.deadlineBody: The contractor is told. Nothing else happens to them.
review.contractorHint: Work type is information only, not a restriction.
review.reopenBody: It goes back to Acknowledged for follow-up work. Earlier photos and feedback are kept. The citizens see your reason.
review.keepBody: The dispute closes and the citizens who said "not fixed" see your reason.
review.flagsNote: Flags never block the workflow. Clear one that doesn't apply, or confirm it as information.
review.clearFlagBody: Say why it doesn't apply. The reason is kept in the audit log.
review.confirmFlagBody: The flag stays as information. The reason is kept in the audit log.
review.linkedHere_one: {{count}} report is linked to this issue.
review.linkedHere_other: {{count}} reports are linked to this issue.
review.evidenceWaiting: Repair evidence is waiting for you
review.contractorNoteHint: Optional. The contractor sees this as written.

repair.title: Repair evidence
repair.location: Where the repair photo was taken
repair.distance: {{distance}} from the issue (phone accuracy {{accuracy}}). A gap is a signal, not proof.
repair.noDevice: No phone location with this photo.
repair.approveBody: The issue becomes Resolved, the repair photo is published, and the reporter and supporters are asked whether it is fixed.
repair.approved: Repair approved. The issue is resolved.
repair.rejectBody: The issue stays In progress. The contractor sees your reason and can send new evidence.
repair.rejectReason: What needs to be redone (shown to the contractor)
repair.pausedNote: The deadline clock is paused while you review.
repair.galleryNote: the photo may be older than it looks; the capture time is not proof. A signal only.

disputes.title: Disputes
disputes.subtitle: Resolved issues where a citizen said "not fixed". Nothing reopens automatically; you decide, with a reason the citizens see.

contractors.title: Contractors
contractors.subtitle: Any admin can invite or deactivate a contractor. Contractors aren't tied to a department.
contractors.search: Search by name, work type, phone or licence
contractors.inviteBody: We check for similar contractors first. Then you get a one-time link to send them; it works once and expires.
contractors.name: Name or company
contractors.workTypeHint: For example roads, electrical, sanitation. Information only.
contractors.similarBody: Check that this isn't the same contractor. If it is a different one, create anyway.
contractors.linkBody: Send this link to the contractor yourself. It is shown only now, works once, and expires.
contractors.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it.
contractors.newLinkTitle: Make a new invite link for {{name}}?
contractors.deactivateBody: They can't log in any more. Nothing is deleted. Their active jobs stay assigned until an admin reassigns them.
contractors.jobsToReassign_one: {{count}} active job in your department to reassign:
contractors.jobsToReassign_other: {{count}} active jobs in your department to reassign:
contractors.otherJobs_one: Plus {{count}} job in another department (its admin reassigns it).
contractors.otherJobs_other: Plus {{count}} jobs in other departments (their admins reassign them).
contractors.reassignNote: Open each issue and use Reassign. Nothing is reassigned automatically.

comments.title: Comments
comments.subtitle: Reported comments on your department's issues. Reports are signals; you decide.
comments.replyHint: Shown to everyone, signed with your department's name. The reporter and supporters get an alert.
comments.replyConfirmBody: It is public and can't be edited or hidden afterwards.
comments.hideBody: Citizens won't see it any more, the author included.
comments.suspendBody: They are logged out and can't log in. Their reports and comments stay; hide comments one by one. You can reactivate the account later.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Who did what, when and why, for your department. Read-only.

deadline.paused: Deadline paused while your evidence is checked (was {{date}})

jobs.title: My jobs
jobs.subtitle: Only jobs assigned to you. Start the work, then send a photo of the repair.

job.photoAlt: The citizen's photo of the problem
job.startBody: The issue becomes In progress and the citizen is told. Send a photo of the repair when you finish.
job.waitingBody: The department reviews it. The deadline is paused until then.
job.noResolve: Only the department can mark an issue resolved, after checking your evidence.
job.notYoursBody: It doesn't exist or isn't assigned to you any more.

evidence.title: Repair evidence
evidence.photoHint: Stand where the citizen stood and frame the same spot. The reference shows their photo.
evidence.overlay: Show the citizen's photo over mine
evidence.galleryNote: A camera photo is preferred. Photos from the gallery are marked for the department.
evidence.locationDenied: Location is off. You can still send; the department will see no location.
evidence.locationUnavailable: Couldn't get your location. You can still send.
evidence.noteHint: What you did, in a few words.
evidence.afterSend: The department checks it. You'll get an alert either way.
evidence.retrySafe: Trying again is safe: it can never send the evidence twice.

notNow.NEW: Start the work before sending evidence.
notNow.SUBMITTED: Your evidence is being checked. You can send new evidence if the department asks for rework.
notNow.OTHER: You can't send evidence for this job now.

submission.title: Evidence status
submission.none: You haven't sent evidence for this job yet.

explain.SUBMITTED: The department is checking your evidence. The deadline is paused until then.
explain.APPROVED: The department approved your repair. The issue is resolved.
explain.REJECTED: The department asked for rework. Fix it and send new evidence.

profile.changeHint: To change these details, ask a department admin.
